title: SFBond 실버폭스 #074 · 식물 · 쇠공 머리 위로 들기 · 체형 curvy petite · Indian · late 40s · 헤어 crown braid wrapping around the head
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

Indian woman, a warm golden-brown complexion, late 40s silver fox goddess, curvy petite physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — smallest most compact frame possible yet curves exploding at absolute maximum in every direction, bubble butt projecting dramatically backward from the tiny frame, thighs so thick they dwarf the petite frame, silver-white crown braid wrapping around the head — full body living chrysanthemum growing directly from her own skin covering EVERY inch of skin from neck to ankle, both legs FULLY covered to ankles — this is living growth, every stem rooted directly into her living skin and every petal standing up in true three-dimensional relief casting its own small shadow, nothing lying flat. BLAZING AMBER chrysanthemum blossoms in full three-dimensional bloom across the full torso both legs neck to ankle, VIVID EMERALD leaves and curling tendrils filling every remaining gap with real depth and texture, every mark crisp and hand-made with clean defined edges, every surface in true three-dimensional relief. A small smudge of soot touches her temple and jaw, with light grime on her fingers and the tops of her bare feet. Her expression is a quiet, serious expression. Restraints: She holds a huge rough-cast black iron ball as big as a bowling ball above her head in both hands, her arms raised straight up and trembling under its weight. Her ankles wear heavy medieval hinged wrought-iron fetters, wide rough-forged iron bands closed with a thick iron pin and riveted, each with a heavy iron ring, each ring linked by a short heavy chain of massive thick black wrought-iron links, each link as thick as a thumb, down and outward to its own huge black iron ring set in the flagstone floor on its own side. Pose: standing full height, facing the camera, her arms raised straight up holding the iron ball above her head, her elbows trembling, her head tilted slightly back under the weight, her bare feet spread about shoulder-width apart flat on the flagstones, her whole body straining, her chest, shoulders and stomach fully in view.
Footwear: bare feet flat on the flagstones, with a little soot on the soles and toes. extra long nails with tiny chrysanthemum petals embedded at each tip.

Background: a medieval stone dungeon torture chamber with rough-cut stone block walls on each side of her, a low vaulted stone ceiling, iron torch sconces with flickering flames on the walls, old iron tools hanging on the stone wall, a damp flagstone floor, dark and moody firelight, dim torchlight and flickering firelight raking across her from one side. A single woman fills the frame. Pattern density MAXIMUM — the pattern wraps her entire body from neck to ankle. Extreme high-gloss oil. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait. portrait 2:3 vertical.
